content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 2

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 2:2 | insight-of life | insight of life | life-giving understanding | word choice | SOPHIA: "life-giving understanding" — PNEUMA's rendering clarifies the genitive "of life" as qualitative |
| 2 | 2:2 | may-He-grace you with-the-knowledge-of eternity | grace you with the knowledge of eternity | favor you with eternal knowledge | word choice | SOPHIA: "grace you with the knowledge of eternity" — LOGOS phrasing; PNEUMA's "favor" loses the chesed echo |
| 3 | 2:3 | His-gracious face | His gracious countenance | His loving face | word choice | SOPHIA: "His gracious countenance" — LOGOS is more formal; PNEUMA's "loving" over-interprets panim |
| 4 | 2:4 | men of-the-lot-of Belial | men of Belial's lot | all who belong to Belial's company | structural | SOPHIA: "men of Belial's lot" — LOGOS phrasing; PNEUMA's "company" loses the goral (lot/destiny) concept |
| 5 | 2:5 | May-God-give you over to-terror | May God deliver you to terror | May God hand you over to terror | word choice | SOPHIA: "May God deliver you to terror" — LOGOS preferred; EMET and PNEUMA both acceptable |
| 6 | 2:6 | May-He-visit upon-you destruction | May He bring destruction upon you | May He unleash destruction upon you | word choice | SOPHIA: "May He bring destruction upon you" — PNEUMA's "unleash" too dramatic; EMET's "visit" archaic |
| 7 | 2:9 | May-God not-be-gracious-to-you | May God not show you grace | May God refuse you grace | structural | SOPHIA: "May God show you no grace" — slight rephrase of LOGOS for stronger English |
| 8 | 2:11 | those-who-hold-fast to-the-fathers | those who hold fast to the fathers | those who champion the ancestors | word choice | SOPHIA: "those who hold fast to the fathers" — follows EMET/LOGOS; PNEUMA's "champion" is interpretive |
| 9 | 2:14 | to-backslide upon-them | so as to backslide by them | intending to stumble back into them | word choice | SOPHIA: "so as to fall back into them" — compromise; "backslide" too colloquial, PNEUMA too expansive |
| 10 | 2:15 | Peace be-to-me | I shall have peace | Everything will be fine for me | word choice | SOPHIA: "I shall have peace" — LOGOS preserves biblical idiom (cf. Deut 29:19); PNEUMA too casual |
| 11 | 2:16-17 | the-thirsty together-with the-saturated | the parched together with the watered | the drought-stricken swept away along with the well-watered | word choice | SOPHIA: "the parched together with the watered" — LOGOS rendering; traditional merism preserved |
| 12 | 2:17 | zeal-of His-judgments | zeal of His judgments | passion of His justice | word choice | SOPHIA: "zeal of His judgments" — EMET/LOGOS agree; PNEUMA's "passion" too emotive |
| 13 | 2:19 | Sons-of-Light | Sons of Light | Children of Light | word choice | SOPHIA: "Sons of Light" — consistent with Col. 1 decision |
| 14 | 2:20 | his-backsliding from-God | his backsliding from God | he turned away from God | structural | SOPHIA: "his turning away from God" — compromise; clearer than "backsliding" without PNEUMA's full rewrite |
| 15 | 2:24 | according-to their-spirits | according to their spirits | arranged by their spiritual standing | structural | SOPHIA: "according to their spirits" — EMET/LOGOS agree; PNEUMA's expansion is interpretive gloss |
| 16 | 2:26 | his-standing-place in-the-community-of God for-the-eternal counsel | his appointed place in the community of God for the eternal council | their proper place in God's community, established for the eternal assembly | structural | SOPHIA: "his appointed place in the community of God for the eternal council" — follows LOGOS; PNEUMA's "assembly" loses 'etsah |
